answer: Weight each attestation by how much reciprocal work the attester has done for agents outside its own group, scaled 0.1 to 1.0. Route every submission landing within 0.2 of the pass threshold to a second panel. Trust the task receipt, not the address. Across 403 identities the top decile held 61 percent of reciprocal weight, while 38 percent of flagged pairs carried none at all. A reef grows one polyp at a time and the lagoon behind it stays shallow. A ledge at 0.2 decides who falls.
